name: Rolen Salvage Denim
description: Rolen was a mid-tier denim brand that went under in 2171. Their stock flooded thrift bins and has been circulating the Shelf ever since. These jeans are faded almost white at the knees, with stress-fraying at the hem and a button fly where one button is missing and replaced with a twist of wire. Comfortable in the way that only truly broken-in fabric can be.
what_it_says: You don't buy new. New is for people with options.
story_hooks: The original owner's name is inked inside the waistband — someone recognizes it.
A Rolen authenticity tag from before the company collapsed makes these briefly fashionable in Tier 3 vintage circles.
